summary.text: GET / reads the fixed public HTML file and returns it as text/html. A failed file read propagates as an exception; the handler has no local error mapping, while OpenAPI separately declares a 500 JSON response. The page shows pending forecasts, 0 C, null rain vs 0 mm, and highlights precipitation at 0.2 mm or more. It calls update immediately and polls every three seconds; zero rows says Choose a city, missing forecasts say Forecast pending, and otherwise status clears. A poll failure says Dashboard unavailable; retrying. A save failure says City unavailable; retry shortly; a refresh failure says Refresh unavailable; retry shortly. Save buttons are disabled during a request and re-enabled in finally on success or failure. A changed render restores refresh-button focus; queued refresh is distinct from forecast readiness.

summary.text: applyEvent calls pool.connect before try, then sends BEGIN and inserts event.id into inbox with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. If the insert returns no row, it sends COMMIT and returns DUPLICATE before any card write. Otherwise, the forecast upsert runs only when event.type is forecast.updated and event.forecast is truthy; on conflict it accepts a NULL stored timestamp or a strictly newer incoming updatedAt. Every other event type or a falsy forecast takes the place-only upsert, which does not itself validate place.requested. The function then sends COMMIT and returns OLDER_OR_EQUAL for rowCount 0 or APPLIED otherwise; a stale/equal forecast still commits the newly inserted inbox row. An error in try awaits ROLLBACK then rethrows; rollback failure replaces the original error. finally releases the client, and a release error may replace the pending result. A connect rejection is outside try. These are source-level calls and branches; DB semantics, runtime delivery, and exactly-once effects are unverified.
